notes: Casino: a new 10× button spins the slots 10 times in a row, with all ten results lined up (press it again to stop), and the points in the top corner now match your real balance after fast spins. Blackjack: while a player is dealing, bets are capped at 1,000. A player dealer who busts on purpose gets a strike; 3 strikes in a day and they're off the dealer seat until tomorrow.
